title: Moving to Dreamland and Freddie Keppard replacing Sugar Johnny
summary: The band crosses the street to Dreamland, with Freddie Keppard taking Sugar Johnny's place.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So, let's see who else came up there. Oh, and after we were up there a while, I don't know exactly how long, we went across the street to Dreamland.
Dreamland. The same band with Dewey and Sugar Johnny and all.

No. Sugar Johnny was taking care while we were there. And Freddie Kepler took his place. Freddie Kepler. Freddie Kepler took his place. Now, I don't remember who was with him when we went across the street. Dreamland. Anyway, we went across that and didn't stay very long. I'm trying to think. I don't know where else would happen. What else did we know?
